warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3-4 at 2.50 + 3.00 + 3.00 (8.50); y = A-B-C-D-E at 2.50 + 1.50 + 3.00 + 1.50 (8.50). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, S-02, S-03, S-04, A-07 (x) and A-08 (y). Vector CAD PDF with no text layer — every value read off the rendered page.

Plan dummies from printed chains: x 1'' 1.40, 2' 3.00, 3' 6.90 (S-02 beam lines B1 / B2 / B1), x 1' -1.00, 2'' 4.00, 4' 9.50 and y A' -1.00, B' 3.50, D' 8.00, E' 9.50 (S-03/S-04 roof chains: overhangs, the T4 ridge line, the eave at D + 1.00).

Three dummies are NOT printed on any plan chain and were measured by proportion (section 4 span amendment, span_source would be scaled_from_grid): x 3'' 7.00 and y A'' 2.00 / C' 5.00 — the lines of the unmarked อกไก่ 2C-150x50x20x3.2 members on S-04. Each agrees with a truss elevation (T2 0.75 panels: 2 panels from the apex on grid 3; T3 1.00/0.50 panels: 1.50 either side of the apex at 3.50), so they carry confidence 0.8 rather than being left out.
x 3' (6.90) and 3'' (7.00) are 0.10 apart — kept both: different things (S-02 floor beam B1 at 3 + 1.40, printed; S-04 roof อกไก่ at 3 + 1.50, scaled).

Truss elevations T1-T5 (S-03, S-04) print panel chains but no grid markers, so they are recorded as floating chains with 'edge' ends and make no lines (section 4 rule 4). Read against the plans they agree: T2 6.00 = grid 2 to 4, T4 6.50 = 1' to 3, T5 9.00 = D' to A', T3 7.00 = A to D, T1 3.00 = E2 to E3. Their member heights (1.89, 1.00, 1.00, 1.03) stay on the truss elements.

z: A-07 and A-08 each print two levels named ระดับหลังอะเส (+4.00, +4.29) and two named ระดับหลังอกไก่ (+5.16, +6.02); the ids keep the printed value so they stay unique. The S-03 segment labels ระดับ +4.00 / ระดับ +4.29 are the same two อะเส levels. ระดับฝ้าเพดาน (A-07/A-08) and ระดับดินเดิม (S-05) print no value and stay null.

Dimension sweep covers S-01..S-06 plus A-07 and A-08 (building sections, for levels). The other architectural/MEP sheets (A-02..A-06, A-09..A-11, E-01, SN-01, SN-02) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run; A-04 (architectural roof plan) reprints the S-04 x chain 1.00 | 2.50 | 3.00 (1.50 | 1.50) | 3.00 | 1.00. S-05 and S-06 print only member-internal dimensions (pile-cap sizes, section sizes, slab thicknesses), which stay on their elements. Material callout sizes in inches (ปั้นลม/เชิงชายไม้เทียม 1" x 8", ผนังผิวกุ 6") are product sizes, not dimensions, and are not recorded.
